syllabus_extract: Lift augmentation. High lift devices. Boundary Layer control
specific_objectives: 6.1.2.1 Trainee will be able to describe various types of aerofoil sections, conditions of performance, theories, and concept related with performance

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Activity: Identification of high lift devices on training aircraft. Safety: Ensure aircraft is chocked and secured. Supervision: Instructor direct observation.
intro_questions: Define lift and its primary dependency on airspeed.
State the effect of increasing angle of attack on lift coefficient.
Recall the definition of stall speed.

development.content:
Concept of lift augmentation
Purpose of high lift devices
Impact on stall speed

Types of leading edge devices
Types of trailing edge devices
Flap configurations and effects

Boundary layer control principles
Vortex generators function
Blown flaps concept

summary_questions: Explain how slats delay stall compared to plain flaps.
Apply boundary layer control concepts to improve low-speed performance.
home_assignment_question: Research the role of secondary flight controls in conjunction with lift augmentation for LP 15.
